t: A tiny low-power chip that talks Bluetooth, Thread, and Zigbee.
steps: Buy a maker board such as the Seeed XIAO nRF52840 from Seeed Studio or the Feather nRF52840 Express from Adafruit. The XIAO starts at about 10 US dollars.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the board package for your board.
Open the Blink example and upload it to see the LED flash.
Try a Bluetooth example next and look for the board in a phone app.
Try CircuitPython on the Feather or XIAO by dragging the file onto the board drive.
Move to the nRF Connect SDK later for Thread, Matter and advanced Bluetooth.
meta: Open Board. From $9.90. A few stores.
